LMSYS SGLang RadixAttention & XGrammar Structured Output Throughput Benchmarks
Ollama / llama.cpp GGUF vs. PagedAttention Continuous Batching High-Concurrency Scaling Studies

workload.enterprise_scenario: 64-Concurrency Enterprise Multi-Turn ReAct Agent & Strict JSON Extraction Workload on 8xH100/H200 (70B FP8 & DeepSeek MoE)
workload.target_sla: P99 TTFT <= 600 ms, P99 Decode TPOT <= 18.0 ms, New-Model Onboarding <= 1.0 Engineering Day
workload.architect_selection_matrix: Ollama/llama.cpp for Local/Edge <=4 users; vLLM V1 for General Multi-Model MaaS & Multi-LoRA; SGLang for Multi-Turn Agents/JSON/DeepSeek; TensorRT-LLM for Dedicated C++ Teams on Frozen Models.

tiers.name: Tier 1: 本地/边缘轻量引擎 Ollama / llama.cpp (GGUF · 适合 1~4 人工作站/AIPC PoC)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Local/Edge Lightweight Engine Ollama / llama.cpp (GGUF · Best for <=4 Users)
tiers.engine_profile: Single-Binary C++ GGUF Runtime (CPU+GPU Offload, Lacks Datacenter Continuous Batching & NVLink TP Scaling)
tiers.recommended_for: Developer laptops (Mac M-Series / RTX), air-gapped edge boxes, and <=4 user PoCs; never use on datacenter H100/H200 clusters.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 静态编译极限引擎 NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM (需专职 C++ 推理优化团队编译 .engine)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Static-Compiled Peak Engine NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM (Dedicated C++ Optimization Team)
tiers.engine_profile: Ahead-of-Time trtllm-build C++ Engine Bound to Exact GPU SKU (SM90/SM100) + Triton Inference Server
tiers.recommended_for: Hyperscalers or single-model high-scale products with 3–5 dedicated C++/CUDA engineers willing to maintain per-SKU engine builds.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 企业级通用标准底座 vLLM V1 (100+ 模型零编译即插即用 + Multi-LoRA + 异构显卡)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Universal Enterprise MaaS Standard vLLM V1 (Day-0 Model Support + Multi-LoRA + Multi-Vendor)
tiers.engine_profile: PagedAttention + APC Prefix Cache + Dynamic Multi-LoRA + NVIDIA/AMD ROCm/AWS Neuron Support
tiers.recommended_for: 80% of enterprise AI platforms: best balance of high throughput (89% of TRT-LLM), zero-compile ops, Multi-LoRA, and hardware portability.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 多轮 Agent、结构化 JSON 与 DeepSeek/MoE 极速引擎 SGLang (RadixAttention + XGrammar)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Multi-Turn Agent, Structured JSON & DeepSeek/MoE Engine SGLang (RadixAttention + XGrammar)
tiers.engine_profile: RadixAttention Automatic Prefix Tree + XGrammar Zero-Overhead JSON FSM + Native DeepSeek MLA/MTP/DeepEP
tiers.recommended_for: Multi-turn ReAct/MCP Agents, strict JSON schema tool calling, and DeepSeek-V3/R1 MoE clusters needing lowest TTFT and $/1M.
